name: OpenCode
run-name: "OpenCode #${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}${{ github.event.issue.title && format(' — {0}', github.event.issue.title) || '' }}"

on:
  issues:
    types: [opened]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: Existing issue to run
        required: true
        type: string

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: opencode-issue-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event.issue.number || inputs.issue_number }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || (github.event.action == 'opened' && contains(github.event.issue.labels.*.name, 'OpenCode'))
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-prepare.yml@cb2ebcf61277bd95065317b4bdbb5bb361b8b54b
    with:
      runtime_ref: cb2ebcf61277bd95065317b4bdbb5bb361b8b54b

  opencode:
    needs: prepare
    if: needs.prepare.outputs.approved == 'true'
    permissions:
      contents: write
      id-token: write
      issues: write
      actions: read
      pull-requests: write
    uses: denaidark/OhMyGithub/.github/workflows/opencode-reusable.yml@cb2ebcf61277bd95065317b4bdbb5bb361b8b54b
    with:
      runtime_ref: cb2ebcf61277bd95065317b4bdbb5bb361b8b54b
      issue_number: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_number }}
      request: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.request }}
      issue_title: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.issue_title }}
      labels_json: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.labels_json }}
      sender: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.sender }}
      target_ref: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_ref }}
      target_sha: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.target_sha }}
    secrets:
      OPENCODE_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_API_KEY }}
      OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON: ${{ secrets.OPENCODE_AUTH_JSON }}
      AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY: ${{ secrets.AGENTSWEB_SSH_PUBLIC_KEY }}

  if "$@"; then

  fi
  ended="$(date +%s%N)"

## Objective
- Continue the saved TV-grid remix from issue #6 in a new conversation, making the 70-channel retro TV app and its 140-channel premium lineup work correctly with an accurate TV guide.

## Requirements
- Include a TV guide whose programming matches exactly what is playing on each channel.
- English-language channels only; 1990s and 2000s content only; full shows or full TV blocks only.
- Keep the existing default channels and expand the local lineup to 70 channels.
- Find retro local-news broadcasts from local news stations.
- Premium is an upgrade with better shows; “Premium: On” must turn 70 channels into 140.

## Decisions
- Restored the stronger 70-channel premium catalog from commit `ad92e92` instead of the thin/random saved catalog, then added `lineupCategory` metadata.
- Made 140 channels the default premium lineup; the 10 optional Plus packs (141–350) remain available but start unchecked.
- Seeded local channels 1–10 with real retro newscasts instead of placeholder films (`the-ghost-busters-1975`, `Why-1995`).
- If a detected city has no archived newscast, channel 1 now falls back to verified retro newscasts rather than a random “Local Vault” clip.
- Removed pre-1990/2010+ and clearly non-English items from premium/extra/genre data; resolved missing years from archive.org metadata.
- Fixed 4:3 video stretching with `object-fit: contain`; added an inline favicon to stop the 404.

## Work State
### Completed
- Restored and enriched the 70 premium channels with 542 valid 1990s/2000s items.
- Sanitized all 210 Plus-pack channels: 566 items, all with 1990–2009 years and no empty playlist channels.
- Replaced pre-1990 genre items and topped every genre channel back up to 3 valid items.
- Updated local seed data in `build_channels.py` and regenerated `channels.js` / `channels.json`.
- Verified default lineup is 140, Premium Off is 70, Plus-pack toggle expands to 161/350, and Reset returns to 140.
- Verified local news fallback, EPG rendering (140 rows), guide/now-playing synchronization, archive playback, premium playback, search, category filtering, and lineup manager.
- Confirmed no console errors after fresh load and no empty playlist channels; all 350 channel numbers unique.

### Active
- Final smoke testing and review of uncommitted changes.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Run a final `git diff`/`git status` review and confirm no unintended files changed.
2. Optionally commit/save the current changes for issue #7.
3. If continuing polish, consider deduplicating the 148 repeated archive IDs between base premium and Plus packs.

## Relevant Files
- `app.js`: lineup defaults, local-news fallback, archive preload, EPG/playback scheduling.
- `premium.js`: restored 70 premium channels with 542 1990s/2000s items.
- `premium_extra.js`: sanitized 210 Plus-pack channels with resolved years.
- `genres.json`: filtered/replaced 1990s/2000s genre programming.
- `channels.js`: generated 70-channel standard lineup with retro-news seeds.
- `channels.json`: JSON source mirror of `channels.js`.
- `build_channels.py`: local seed and genre-channel generator.
- `index.html`: lineup note, initial count, inline favicon.
- `styles.css`: `object-fit: contain` video fix.
- `start.sh`: builds `dist/` and serves on port 3002.
- `/tmp/opencode/resolve_years.py`: archive metadata year-resolution script used for extra items.
- `/tmp/opencode/apply_years.py`: applied resolved years to `premium_extra.js`.

## Important Context
- Working branch: `opencode/41242911236`; changes are currently uncommitted.
- Server test command: `PORT=3002 ./start.sh`; app served from `dist/` on `http://localhost:3002`.
- Browser testing uses `playwright-cli`; favicon and console checks passed after fresh `open`.

- Base premium has 8 packages; plus packs bring total to 18 packages and 350 channels.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

PROJECT_DIR="$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd -P)"
cd "$PROJECT_DIR"

OPENCODE_WEB_DIR="${OPENCODE_WEB_DIR:-/home/runner/work/_temp/omgithub-web}"
BUILD_DIR="$PROJECT_DIR/dist"
DEPLOY_FILE="$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR/deployment-output.json"
PORT="${PORT:-3000}"
export PORT

log() {
  printf '[start] %s %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$*" >&2
}

run_timed() {
  local started ended status elapsed_ms
  started="$(date +%s%N)"
  log "run: $*"
  if "$@"; then
    status=0
  else
    status=$?
  fi
  ended="$(date +%s%N)"
  elapsed_ms=$(( (ended - started) / 1000000 ))
  log "done: $* (${elapsed_ms}ms, exit $status)"
  return "$status"
}

prepare_build() {
  run_timed rm -rf "$BUILD_DIR"
  run_timed mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR"
}

install_dependencies() {
  if [[ ! -f package.json ]]; then
    log "no package.json; using the static project sources"
    return 0
  fi
  if [[ -f package-lock.json ]]; then
    run_timed npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
  else
    run_timed npm install --no-audit --no-fund
  fi
  if run_timed node -e 'const p=require("./package.json"); process.exit(p.scripts && p.scripts.build ? 0 : 1)'; then
    run_timed npm run build
  fi
}

copy_static() {
  local files=(index.html app.js channels.js premium.js premium_extra.js styles.css server.js)
  local file
  run_timed mkdir -p "$BUILD_DIR/vendor"
  for file in "${files[@]}"; do
    if [[ ! -f "$file" ]]; then
      log "missing required static file: $file"
      return 1
    fi
    run_timed cp "$file" "$BUILD_DIR/$file"
  done
  run_timed cp -R vendor/. "$BUILD_DIR/vendor/"
}

write_deployment_output() {
  local temporary
  run_timed mkdir -p "$OPENCODE_WEB_DIR"
  temporary="$DEPLOY_FILE.tmp.$$"
  printf '{"project":"%s","directory":"%s"}\n' "$PROJECT_DIR" "$BUILD_DIR" > "$temporary"
  run_timed mv "$temporary" "$DEPLOY_FILE"
}

if ! command -v node >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  log "node is required to serve the static build"
  exit 1
fi
